subject: Ops activation: Monitoring & runbook playbook for Nightingale POC
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Chen <alice@nightingale.com>, Benjamin Ortiz <benjamin@nightingale.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Ops activation: Monitoring & runbook playbook for Nightingale POC

Hi Alice / Ben —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for the Nightingale POC. To make the implementation practical for your week-1 acceptance criteria, I want to align on a concise ops activation playbook focused on three deliverables we discussed:

- Dashboard bundle (Grafana) covering request/latency, token-level cost, model-fallback rates
- Tracing hooks (OpenTelemetry spans + sample integration) and a suggested service map
- Error taxonomy + alert routing plan and an initial runbook for common incidents (model OOM, KV cache corruption, inference-queue saturation)

Attached: activation_checklist.pdf and a simple service-map.png.

Requests from your side to proceed:
1) Grafana viewer invite (URL or org id) or read-only API key
2) Access to traces endpoint or a short OTLP example event
3) PagerDuty service ID or preferred on-call rotation for POC alerts
4) Any restricted IP ranges or SSO constraints we should know about

Proposed timeline: kickoff call this Friday 4/23, initial dashboards by 4/26, tracing prototype by 4/30, runbook draft 5/3. If that works we’ll send a one-page mutual action plan.

Owners: I’ll own the runbook draft; Marissa will lead dashboards; Hannah will own tracing hooks; Connor will coordinate alert routing integration.

Would Friday 4/23 at 10:00am PT work for a 30-min sync?

Thanks —
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

From: Alice Chen <alice@nightingale.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Benjamin Ortiz <benjamin@nightingale.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ops activation: Monitoring & runbook playbook for Nightingale POC

Thanks Rishi — Friday 10:00am PT works for us. Quick clarifications from Nightingale infra:

- We can create a Grafana "viewer" role for the redwood team but we require invites to go through our SSO (Okta). I will loop in our SSO admin Ben below.
- For PagerDuty, we typically want informational alerts to go to a Slack channel and only high-severity incidents to trigger phone-based escalation. Can Redwood support that split during the POC?
- On SLOs: our baseline is 95th latency < 450ms and no more than 1% error rate on production-like traffic. Will the dashboards include percentile breakdowns by model variant?

Ben — can you provide the service owner contact and whether we can generate a machine user for Grafana?

Appreciate the clear owners. We'll aim to get the invites over by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Alice Chen
Director of Platform Engineering, Nightingale Analytics
alice@nightingale.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Chen <alice@nightingale.com>, Benjamin Ortiz <benjamin@nightingale.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ops activation: Monitoring & runbook playbook for Nightingale POC

Perfect — thanks Alice. Quick answers and proposed MAP (mutual action plan) bullets below; attaching MAP-v1.xlsx for tracking.

On PagerDuty routing: yes — we can route low-priority alerts to Slack and configure phone/ SMS for Sev2+. We will instrument severity mappings in the runbook so your on-call team sees consistent triage instructions.

Dashboards / SLOs: Marissa will template dashboards with p50/p95/p99 and breakdowns by model variant label. We will include a small panel showing model-fallback counts (when a cheaper variant is used) and token-cost/time heatmaps.

Immediate MAP (owner / due):
- Grafana viewer invite (Nightingale) / Ben / 2027-04-22 EOD
- Provide sample error log lines and a recent trace (Nightingale) / Ben / 2027-04-23
- Dashboard template delivery (Marissa) / Marissa / 2027-04-26
- Tracing prototype + sample spans (Hannah) / Hannah / 2027-04-30
- Initial runbook draft (Rishi) / Rishi / 2027-05-03

If Ben can drop the Grafana invite + PagerDuty service id today or tomorrow, Marissa and Hannah will get started immediately.

Thanks — looking forward to Friday's sync.

Rishi

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Alice Chen <alice@nightingale.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ops activation: Monitoring & runbook playbook for Nightingale POC

Following up from our side with the dashboard plan and a small ask for the shape of your telemetry. I attached dashboard-template.json (Grafana export) that we will import. Notes:

- Panels: Request rate (total + by endpoint), Model latency histogram (with p50/p95/p99), Token cost per request (avg + 90th), Fallback ratio by variant, Error rate with taxonomy tag.
- Required metric names/labels we expect: redwood.request.latency_ms, redwood.request.tokens, redwood.model.variant, redwood.request.status_code, redwood.kvcache.hit_ratio. If your naming differs we can map, but please let us know.
- For traces we will add a small span instrument that attaches model.variant and prompt_length to the root span; Hannah will send a proto-instrumentation snippet.

Action items for Nightingale (please drop into MAP-v1.xlsx):
- Provide 7 days of sample metrics (Prometheus/Grafana export or CSV)
- Share 2 anonymized trace samples (OTLP) and a sample error log line for each common failure mode
- Confirm preferred Slack channel and PagerDuty service id

Marissa
Principal Developer Advocate, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachment: dashboard-template.json (Grafana dashboard export)

From: Benjamin Ortiz <benjamin@nightingale.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alice Chen <alice@nightingale.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ops activation: Monitoring & runbook playbook for Nightingale POC

Hi all — forwarding the invites / keys as requested.

- Grafana: invite sent to rishi@redwood.ai (viewer role) via Okta SSO; if you don't see it, let me know and I'll add a machine user.
- PagerDuty: Service ID PD-SVC-9987, integration key attached to our internal vault. We will create a Slack escalation rule that posts to #infra-alerts for informational alerts and triggers PD for Sev2+.
- Trace samples: uploaded two OTLP JSON snippets to the shared Nightingale S3 (link in MAP-v1.xlsx).
- Sample error log: included three anonymized lines showing OOM and KV miss patterns.

Looking forward to the Friday sync — Ben and I will be on the call and can review access behavior live.
